chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umeyr, from Jameel, who said:

I said to Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him): A 'Mudabbir' (a slave promised freedom upon his master's death) killed a man by error. Who is responsible for him? He (peace be upon him) said: His master reconciles on his behalf. But if they refuse, he is handed over to the guardians of the killed one to serve them until the one who promised him freedom dies. Then he returns as free, and there is no way against him. And in another report: And he is sought to be compensated for his value.

key_terms.حُرّاً: Hurran: Free (as opposed to a slave).
key_terms.لَا سَبِيلَ: La sabila: No way/authority (to keep him enslaved).
key_terms.مُدَبَّر: Mudabbir: A slave whose master promises him freedom upon the master's death.
key_terms.يُسْتَسْعَى: Yustas'ha: He is sought to be compensated/sued for.

ai.seo_question: Who pays the blood money if a Mudabbir kills someone accidentally?
ai.summary: This ruling from al-Kafi highlights the unique legal status of the 'Mudabbir' in Shia jurisprudence, where the master bears primary liability for accidental homicide committed by the slave. If the master refuses to pay, the Mudabbir serves the heirs as a form of deferred compensation until the master's death, at which point he is manumitted, illustrating the interplay between debt satisfaction and freedom. The alternative narration regarding seeking compensation for his value underscores the practical mechanisms for ensuring the victim's heirs receive due restitution.

en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Jameel who said,

‘I said to Abu Abdullahasws, ‘A ‘Mudabbir’ (Slave promised freedom upon the death of his master), who killed a man in error, who is responsible from him?’ Heasws said: ‘His master has to reconcile from him. But, if they refuse, he would be handed over to the guardians of the killed one to serve them until he dies, the one who had promised him freedom. Then he is returned as free, there not being a way against him’. And in another report: ‘And he has to work regarding his value’.
